title: xppautX .setx settings
description: A settings file of a model: the numerics (the option table's keys), the values, the delays, the boundary conditions and the active window's graphics, in the options syntax. Generated from core/setx_file.cpp and core/model_options.cpp by xppautX --setx-schema. The groups named by the model's variables or parameters hold one entry for each name.

total_time.title: Total time
total_time.description: How long a run integrates, in model time.

start_time.title: Start time
start_time.description: The time a run starts at.

dt.title: Dt
dt.description: The time step of a fixed-step method, and the first step of an adaptive one.

store_every.title: Store every N steps
store_every.description: Keep one step of every this many in the data table.

store_from.title: Store from
store_from.description: Keep no data before this time; the run before it is a transient.

state_limit.title: State limit
state_limit.description: A state beyond plus or minus this value stops the run.

stop_at_limit.title: Stop at the limit
stop_at_limit.description: Whether a state beyond the state limit stops the run, or only marks it.

subsystem_split.title: Subsystem split
subsystem_split.description: What splits the model into independent subsystems: its equations alone, or also the run (a Poincare section or stop).

relative_tolerance.title: Relative tolerance
relative_tolerance.description: The relative error an adaptive method accepts in one step.

absolute_tolerance.title: Absolute tolerance
absolute_tolerance.description: The absolute error an adaptive method accepts in one step.

min_step.title: Minimum step
min_step.description: The smallest step an adaptive method takes before it gives up.

max_step.title: Maximum step
max_step.description: The largest step an adaptive method takes.

jacobian.title: Jacobian
jacobian.description: Whether an implicit method gets the Jacobian by differences or from the exact derivatives.

delay.title: Maximal delay
delay.description: The longest delay a model uses; it sets how much history is kept.

vmaxpts.title: Delay history points
vmaxpts.description: How many past points of the history a delay model keeps.

eul_tol.title: Newton tolerance
eul_tol.description: The Newton tolerance of the implicit Euler method.

eul_iter.title: Newton iterations
eul_iter.description: The most Newton iterations the implicit Euler method makes in a step.

bvp_max_iterates.title: BVP maximum iterates
bvp_max_iterates.description: The most Newton iterates a boundary value solve makes.

bvp_tolerance.title: BVP tolerance
bvp_tolerance.description: The tolerance a boundary value solve stops at.

bvp_epsilon.title: BVP epsilon
bvp_epsilon.description: The step that differences the boundary value problem's Jacobian.

poincare_map.title: Map
poincare_map.description: What a run records at a Poincare section: nothing, the section, the maxima or the period.

poincare_variable.title: Variable
poincare_variable.description: The variable the Poincare section is taken on.

poincare_sign.title: Sign
poincare_sign.description: Which crossings of the section count: upward, downward or both.

poincare_plane.title: Plane
poincare_plane.description: The value of the variable at the section.

poincare_stop.title: Stop
poincare_stop.description: Whether a crossing of the section stops the run.

max_iterations.title: Equilibria: maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most Newton iterations the search for an equilibrium makes.

newton_tolerance.title: Equilibria: Newton tolerance
newton_tolerance.description: The tolerance the search for an equilibrium stops at.

jacobian_step.title: Equilibria: Jacobian step
jacobian_step.description: The step that differences the Jacobian of the equilibrium search.

search_limit.title: Equilibria: search limit
search_limit.description: A state beyond plus or minus this value ends the equilibrium search.

print_eigenvalues.title: Equilibria: print eigenvalues
print_eigenvalues.description: Whether the eigenvalues of an equilibrium are printed.

draw_invariant_sets.title: Equilibria: draw invariant sets
draw_invariant_sets.description: Whether the stable and unstable sets of a saddle are drawn.

draw_strong_sets.title: Equilibria: draw strong sets
draw_strong_sets.description: Whether the strong stable and unstable sets are drawn.

nullcline_mesh.title: Nullcline mesh
nullcline_mesh.description: How many points a side the nullclines are found on.

rangeover.title: Variable
rangeover.description: The parameter or variable a sweep varies.

rangestep.title: Steps
rangestep.description: How many steps the sweep makes between its ends.

rangelow.title: Low
rangelow.description: The value the sweep starts at.

rangehigh.title: High
rangehigh.description: The value the sweep ends at.

rangereset.title: Reset
rangereset.description: Whether each run of the sweep starts from the initial conditions.

rangeoldic.title: Old ic
rangeoldic.description: Whether each run of the sweep starts where the one before ended.

rangefiles.title: Write files
rangefiles.description: Whether each run of the sweep is written to a file of its own.
